title: 14-Day AI & Architecture Sprint
description: A fixed-scope, 14-day Techlio sprint: a working AI prototype on your data, an architecture decision record, an eval baseline and a build estimate.
h1: A working AI prototype and a build-ready architecture in 14 days.
intro: Two weeks with a senior Techlio team. You finish with a prototype running on your own data, the architecture to take it to production, and the numbers to decide whether you should.
audienceIntro: It fits when you need evidence before a bigger commitment.

audience.title: Founders raising or just funded
audience.text: You need something real to show investors and first customers, and a credible plan for what the round will build.

audience.title: Engineering leaders with a mandate
audience.text: Leadership wants AI in the product. You want a prototype and an architecture before you commit headcount.

audience.title: Teams quoted months of discovery
audience.text: You have been offered a long discovery phase and would rather learn by building the riskiest part first.

steps.title: Lock the scope
steps.text: One use case, one success measure, data access confirmed. Anything that does not fit is written down for later.

steps.title: Architecture and evals
steps.text: We design the system and build the eval set from your real cases, so progress is measured from the first commit.

steps.title: Build the prototype
steps.text: A working prototype on your data with daily builds you can try. Guardrails are in from the start.

steps.title: Harden and hand over
steps.text: Final eval run, a walkthrough with your team, and a written recommendation: build, change course or stop.

deliverables: Working prototype running on your data
whyTitle: Why a sprint beats a long discovery

why.title: Scope that cannot creep
why.text: One use case and fourteen days. The constraint forces the decisions that long discoveries postpone.

why.title: Seniors on the keyboard
why.text: The engineers who scope the sprint build it. Nothing is handed down to a junior team after the kickoff.

why.title: Nothing thrown away
why.text: The prototype is built on the production architecture, so a go decision continues the same codebase.

closeTitle: Have a use case worth two weeks?
closeText: Tell us the problem and the data you have. We will confirm within 24 hours whether it fits a sprint.
